title: Obvious or Commonly Known Danger
description: Manufacturer not liable for obvious dangers

content.general_rule: A product manufacturer shall not be liable for failure to instruct or warn about a danger which is obvious or commonly known to the user or consumer of such product or which, such user or consumer, ought to have known, taking into account the characteristics of such product.
content.exception: shall not be liable for failure to instruct or warn about a danger which is obvious or commonly known to the user or consumer
conditions: the danger is commonly known to the user or consumer
the user or consumer ought to have known, taking into account the characteristics of such product
